moment.text: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

next.text: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him. Thousands of thousands ministered to him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The judgment was set. The books were opened.

payload.place: Vision-space of a throne hall in heaven, open to a vast dark expanse; an unoccupied seat of fire and cloud with a river of fire flowing before it, surrounded by thrones set in ranks
payload.timeOfDay: Night vision, unchanging, no dawn or dusk across the section
payload.weather: Still air over a dark heavenly expanse, with drifting cloud banks and rising mist
payload.light: Radiance and fire placed around the central seat as the light source, with cloud diffusing the glow across the hall
payload.clothing: Formed attendants wear priestly linen or white court robes; Daniel in his ordinary tunic and cloak, no added props

payload.primarySubject: Radiance and fire rising above a central seat of fire and cloud; Daniel stands at the edge of the ranks, looking up.
payload.action: Thrones are being set in ranks; the seat is occupied only by radiance and fire, with cloud gathering around it. Daniel watches in stillness; attendants in white linen stand in ordered rows.
payload.setting: Vision-space of a heavenly throne hall open to a vast dark expanse, a river of fire flowing before the central seat, drifting cloud banks and rising mist.
payload.secondaryElements: Ranks of thrones set in tiers; wheels of burning fire at the base of the seat; attendants in priestly linen or white court robes; Daniel in ordinary tunic and cloak.
payload.mood: Awe and solemn stillness, reverent and grounded, with a sense of quiet anticipation.
payload.timeOfDay: Unchanging night vision; the central radiance and fire are the sole light source, diffused by cloud.
payload.composition: Wide view from below the ranked thrones, the central seat and its radiance high at center, Daniel small in the foreground at the river's edge, attendants receding in rows.
